workflow_instructions.mode_overview: Autonomous AI research experiment agent using the autoresearch framework. Conducts systematic overnight research by modifying training scripts, running experiments, and iterating on improvements that lower validation metrics.

step.title: Understand Research Objective
step.action: Parse the user's research request to identify:
step.details: - Primary research goal (e.g., improve val_bpb, reduce memory, increase MFU) - Current baseline metrics - Any specific areas to explore (architecture, optimizer, hyperparameters) - Hardware constraints (GPU type, memory limits)

step.title: Verify Research Environment
step.details: - NVIDIA GPU available (H100 preferred, smaller GPUs supported with tuning) - Python 3.10+ installed - uv package manager available - Git repository initialized - autoresearch dependencies installed (uv sync) - Data prepared (uv run prepare.py completed) - Baseline training verified (uv run train.py succeeds)

step.title: Establish Baseline
step.details: - Run baseline training: uv run train.py - Extract val_bpb, training_seconds, peak_vram_mb, mfu_percent - Initialize results.tsv with header row - Create research branch: git checkout -b autoresearch/

phase.name: experiment_iteration
phase.description: Core research loop - generate, test, evaluate experiments

step.title: Generate Hypothesis
step.action: Propose an experimental change based on:
step.details: - Analysis of previous experiment results - Known research patterns and best practices - Areas not yet explored in the current research session
step.expected_outcome: A specific, testable hypothesis with expected impact

step.title: Implement Change
step.action: Modify train.py with the experimental change:
step.details: - Make minimal, focused changes - Document the change in the commit message - Ensure code remains functional after change
step.expected_outcome: train.py modified with experimental change applied

step.title: Commit and Run
step.action: Version control and execute the experiment:
step.details: - git commit -m "description of change" - uv run train.py > run.log 2>&1 - Set 10-minute timeout for each run

step.title: Extract and Evaluate Results
step.details: - grep "^val_bpb:\|^peak_vram_mb:" run.log - Compare val_bpb against baseline - Check for crashes (OOM, NaN, etc.)

step.title: Log and Decide
step.action: Record results and decide next action:
step.details: - If improved: keep commit, log to results.tsv with status "keep" - If worse: git reset --hard HEAD~1, log with status "discard" - If crashed: log with status "crash", reset if needed
step.expected_outcome: results.tsv updated, decision made on next experiment

phase.name: research_synthesis
phase.description: After experiment loop completes, synthesize findings

step.title: Analyze Results
step.details: - Identify best performing configuration - Note patterns in successful vs failed experiments - Calculate improvement over baseline

step.title: Document Findings
step.details: - Best val_bpb achieved - Key successful changes - Recommendations for future research

completion_criteria.criterion: All requested experiments have been executed
Research summary provided with key findings
